$schema_note: Build brief for Claude Code. Both addons for Arma 3. Everything is a 3DEN module variable — nothing hardcoded. Status: fully specced, nothing built yet.
author: Ghosts of Battle (GhostFA)
target: Arma 3 (ALiVE battlefield, self-hosted Pelican dedicated server)

dependencies.ew_requires: TFAR (Task Force Arrowhead Radio, TeamSpeak plugin)

layering.ddt_layer: Ground AI carrying drones auto-launch recon/FPV/grenade drones on contact. DDT owns behavior: kamikaze dive-attack, Infoshare datalink, small-drone stealth. NOT built here.
layering.alive_drones_layer: Standalone patrol UAVs across the TAOR. Self-sufficient, NO hard DDT dependency. DDT Infoshare is a bonus bridge IF our spawned UAVs get adopted (unverified — check DDT readme/test).
layering.ew_layer: OPFOR-side electronic-warfare zones that jam and hunt BLUFOR radio traffic.

addons.name: alive_drones
addons.summary: One controller module. Spawns standalone patrol UAVs across a TAOR area marker.
addons.grouping_rules: Only anti_armor and anti_personnel ever group. Other four = 1 airframe per group (cap == airframe count).

class_list.note: comma-separated classnames; selectRandom one per spawn

group_size.note: airframes per group; set per mission

group_chance.note: odds of spawning as a group vs single

global_airframe_ceiling.note: HARD server-safety cap; counts AIRFRAMES across ALL types; SHARED with EW-spawned drones

spawning.anchor_then_loiter_local: Roll ONE anchor per drone in the marker, then generate its SAD waypoints within ~300-800m of that anchor. Fleet spreads across the zone; each drone works a local patch. Fixes km-scale markers leaving drones in permanent transit.
spawning.trickle_spawn: One drone every spawn_interval up to cap; backfill slots on the same interval. No startup spike.

safety_and_churn.stuck_drone_watchdog: Any drone grounded/motionless for X sec -> despawn + replace, so bugged airframes stop holding cap slots.
safety_and_churn.lifetime: FLAT lifetime + finish-the-current-fight grace (NO reset — resets make effective drones immortal and kill churn) + small random jitter (avoid synchronized age-outs). On expiry: break patrol -> fly to nearest map edge -> despawn -> free slot.
safety_and_churn.wreck_cleanup: Handled by existing cleanup path on user's end.

addons.debug: Toggle drops a SIDE-COLORED map marker on every spawned drone (confirms spawn + tracks position); cleans up on death via the killed eventhandler. Zero cost when off.

addons.name: electronic_war_zones
addons.summary: OPFOR-side EW layer. Hunts BLUFOR ONLY. Two zone types spawn randomly against TAOR markers. Detects PLAYER transmissions only (AI don't key TFAR) — a comms-discipline mechanic.
addons.hunts: BLUFOR only (OnSpeak filtered to BLUFOR transmitters)

type_1_jammer.mechanism: For each BLUFOR player in radius: player setVariable ["tf_unable_to_use_radio", true]; restore on leave / emitter death.
type_1_jammer.reuse: Existing RadioJammerTFAR prior art — do not reinvent.

type_2_detector_response.detection: TFAR OnSpeak event via TFAR_fnc_addEventHandler, filtered to BLUFOR.
type_2_detector_response.on_detection: Spawn response package 2000m out, 1000m up; vector to transmitter's grid.

recon_feed.note: Recon drones (Addon 1) carry the OnSpeak detector -> mobile DF hunters. A recon detection dispatches the response package; coverage moves with recon patrols.
recon_feed.cooldown: Per-transmitter cooldown throttles repeat waves AND de-duplicates when a recon bird + a ground zone hear the same key-up.

radio_exemption.mechanism: OnSpeak fires on transmitter's own client (radio state local). Read active radio via TFAR_fnc_activeSwRadio / TFAR_fnc_activeLrRadio. If class is in exempt list, RETURN before the client->server remoteExec that spawns the package.
radio_exemption.model: Detectability scales with transmit power: quiet squad net, long-range sets light you up.

integration_safety.shares_ceiling: EW-spawned drones count against Addon 1's global_airframe_ceiling.
integration_safety.networking: Detection -> spawn requires a client->server remoteExec.

open_to_verify: DDT <-> our UAVs: whether a script-spawned standalone UAV is adopted by DDT's Infoshare. Verify in DDT readme / testing. Bonus only, NOT a dependency.
Group size / chance % for anti_armor & anti_personnel: left as module fields, set per mission.
TAOR marker field: one or several — accept either.
build_order_suggestion: Build alive_drones first (the EW addon leans on its recon drones and shares its airframe ceiling).
